name: e2e
description: End-to-end test agent skills, from sonhyrd/e2e-skills. pw-prove: prove a PR/branch/ticket/diff with a Playwright E2E test, fast. e2e-reviewer: static review of Playwright/Cypress specs and Page Objects, catching tests that pass CI but prove nothing. playwright-debugger: root-cause diagnosis of failed Playwright runs from reports, traces and screenshots. All three are model-invocable and chain, and pw-prove confirms before a model-invoked run.
